facts.text: Season 4 premiered August 12, 2026 and adapts Gone Tomorrow (book #13 in Lee Child's series) — the show doesn't follow publication order at all (S1=Killing Floor #1, S2=Bad Luck and Trouble #11, S3=Persuader #7), which works because each novel is a standalone thriller starting fresh in a new city.

Unlike the first three seasons, all set in small towns, Season 4 moves the action to Philadelphia — Reacher gets pulled into a conspiracy involving a missing USB drive after meeting a troubled woman on a train.

Lee Child personally signed off on Alan Ritchson's casting, calling his build "perfectly accurate" to the books — a direct contrast to the earlier Tom Cruise films, where Child later admitted "the readers, ultimately, were right" to object to the casting.

Ritchson put on real muscle for the role (reports vary 30-35 lbs) through short, high-intensity strength-and-speed training rather than pure bodybuilding — his own words: "I couldn't just bulk up like a bodybuilder — I had to train for strength and speed."
Season 4 holds a 94% critics' score on Rotten Tomatoes — technically the series' lowest (S1 92%, S2 and S3 both 98%) but still a strong, well-reviewed season by any normal standard.
